Minbox text archive

Privacy policy

Last updated October 14, 2026. This policy describes owner-managed installations and the fixture-tested Mac/iPhone path. Live Mac/iPhone operation remains unverified.

What the application handles

Minbox processes accessible message text, sender and recipient identifiers, conversation identifiers, timestamps, revisions, attachment metadata, and available images.

Optional local OCR extracts text from images. Minbox can also collect accessible transcripts from Loom links in messages. Restricted videos and unavailable formats remain reported gaps.

Where information is stored

Original archives, settings, and credentials stay on the owner's collection computer. The administrator of that computer can access its local data.

If you choose Drive publication, private output copies are stored in your Google Drive. The optional local export creates a separate filtered text folder.

File permissions restrict access but do not guarantee encryption at rest. Device encryption and independent backups need separate setup.

Source updates do not contain your archive or account credentials.

Google account permissions

For a new Drive connection, you create a private folder and select it in Google's folder picker. Minbox requests drive.file for selected and app-created files.

It does not request access to browse or manage your entire Drive or Google Sheets.

Minbox follows the selected folder's ID, so renaming the folder preserves the connection. It verifies the owner and managed root and parent folders.

Google's access is per file, not recursive folder authorization. Existing archive items can require separate selection during migration. Unrelated folder contents are not imported or managed.

Older broad Drive or retired Sheets grants need an explicit permission migration and fresh consent.

Minbox maintains private folders and Docs, reads designated corrections, and verifies outputs. It does not ask you to make your archive public.

AI services and other providers

Routine collection, full publication, and local text export use local rules without model calls.

A setup agent using a cloud model can receive originals returned by its tools. An AI app with broad computer access can read beyond the filtered folder.

Optional work analysis sends selected eligible message and transcript content to its configured provider. Your chosen retrieval connection can send returned content to the answering AI provider.

That service has its own access permissions and policies. Granting Minbox access does not configure or restrict the AI service's separate grant.

A local-model filtering stage is an adaptation option, not an included backend. Local-only processing needs checks for remote inference, fallback, telemetry, and logs.

Google stores Drive files. Loom handles linked-transcript requests. Provider retention and training settings depend on the provider and account.

Minbox does not promise that all third-party processing stays on your device.

Filtering, retention and removal

The supplied security rules withhold authentication codes, recognizable password-reset links, and clear promotional spam from filtered archive views.

Active explicit spam corrections also exclude their sources. The optional analyzer has separate filtering gates.

These protections do not restrict a setup agent or broadly authorized app from reading originals. No rule set detects every secret.

Local imports can retain excluded records. Filtering output is not deletion from the original archive.

Local history and revisions remain until explicitly removed. Stopping or uninstalling background jobs preserves data and credentials.

To stop Google access, revoke the application in your Google Account's third-party connections. Its current branding is minbox-text-archive.

Delete unwanted Drive files separately. Arrange local archive and credential removal with the installation administrator.

Earlier document revisions, uploaded images, provider copies, and cached answers can remain after a filter change. Manage provider copies with that service.

Health notifications

Normal operation and ordinary recovery stay local. Optional external email covers unresolved emergencies that require human action.

Notices use fixed operational wording, configured owner names, and recovery counts. They exclude message bodies, contacts, source identifiers, credentials, and provider error text.

No routine, reminder, or recovery mail is sent.

This information website

These static pages do not request messages, Google sign-in, or uploads. They contain no analytics scripts or cookies.

The hosting provider can keep normal request logs under its own policies.

Contact

For questions or data-removal help, email spencer.r.h@gmail.com. Minbox does not sell message content or use it for advertising.
